detailed_descriptions.en: Love in Summer is a fully dynamic live-action interactive romance simulation. This summer vacation, you will embark on a lighthearted youth journey with four young women of distinct personalities. Within this summer, there is ambiguity, tension, laughter, and touching moments. There will be many summers in life, yet none will burn as bright as this one. Gentle, thoughtful and intelligent senior school beauty — Liu Shilin Co-founder of "Heta" Photography Studio, in charge of daily studio operations. "Where are we all bound for? Such a silly question, yet no one has the answer." Cool on the surface, warm at heart artistic senior — Li Feier Co-founder of "Heta" Photography Studio, responsible for the studio’s artistic creation. "Trapped by this unsolvable mundane life. Sorrow runs on forever, just like the river flowing east." Whimsical and mischievous young model — Xia Wei Exclusive model of "Heta" Photography Studio, talented in singing and dancing. "You wave your hands in delight, while I stare blankly, lost in your sweet smile." Cute and innocent childhood sweetheart next door — Le Tong The most reliable backup member of "Heta" Photography Studio. After the college entrance exam, she sneaks to campus to meet you without telling her family. "I was eighteen that year. My heart skipped a beat the moment I laid eyes on you." First-Person Immersion Filmed in first-person perspective to boost scene and narrative immersion, delivering a fully immersive romantic interactive experience. Branching Choices & Multiple Endings Every choice you make shapes how the seniors and underclasswomen feel about you, and ultimately determines your endings with each of them. Authentic Youth & Subtle Emotions Centered on ordinary college campus life. It tells a genuine, nuanced coming-of-age story in a grounded, realistic style. Youth is when a group of people gather and wholeheartedly pursue one thing. Regrets may come along the way, but no matter how things turn out, the journey itself holds meaning. In an era flooded with diverse interactive film games, we chose to slow down, return to basics, and craft a pure, simple story rooted in campus youth. We hope you enjoy this work.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Love in Summer is a fully dynamic live-action interactive romance simulation. This summer vacation, you will embark on a lighthearted youth journey with four young women of distinct personalities. Within this summer, there is ambiguity, tension, laughter, and touching moments.

There will be many summers in life, yet none will burn as bright as this one.

Gentle, thoughtful and intelligent senior school beauty — Liu Shilin Co-founder of "Heta" Photography Studio, in charge of daily studio operations. "Where are we all bound for? Such a silly question, yet no one has the answer."

Cool on the surface, warm at heart artistic senior — Li Feier Co-founder of "Heta" Photography Studio, responsible for the studio’s artistic creation. "Trapped by this unsolvable mundane life. Sorrow runs on forever, just like the river flowing east."

Whimsical and mischievous young model — Xia Wei Exclusive model of "Heta" Photography Studio, talented in singing and dancing. "You wave your hands in delight, while I stare blankly, lost in your sweet smile."

Cute and innocent childhood sweetheart next door — Le Tong The most reliable backup member of "Heta" Photography Studio. After the college entrance exam, she sneaks to campus to meet you without telling her family. "I was eighteen that year. My heart skipped a beat the moment I laid eyes on you."

First-Person Immersion Filmed in first-person perspective to boost scene and narrative immersion, delivering a fully immersive romantic interactive experience.

Branching Choices & Multiple Endings Every choice you make shapes how the seniors and underclasswomen feel about you, and ultimately determines your endings with each of them.

Authentic Youth & Subtle Emotions Centered on ordinary college campus life. It tells a genuine, nuanced coming-of-age story in a grounded, realistic style.

Youth is when a group of people gather and wholeheartedly pursue one thing. Regrets may come along the way, but no matter how things turn out, the journey itself holds meaning.

In an era flooded with diverse interactive film games, we chose to slow down, return to basics, and craft a pure, simple story rooted in campus youth. We hope you enjoy this work.
